data.rationale: The proposal has the same steps in the same order (Careers, Openings, Country, Team, Time Type, Search, open job) and the right three filter parameters. It leaves out the action parameter (open or save/apply) and doesn't name which job to open, so an automation couldn't pick the target job or the final action from the spec alone.
